top_signals.title: Yuan Popularity Boost Likely Focus of Hong Kong’s Five-Year Plan
top_signals.summary: Measures to promote wider offshore use of the yuan are likely to feature prominently in Hong Kong’s inaugural five-year plan, along with new financial products including commodities futures, according to analysts.

top_signals.title: Samsung Faces Local Hedge Fund’s Push to Cancel Preferred Shares
top_signals.summary: A South Korean hedge fund is urging Samsung Electronics Co. to buy back and cancel preferred shares, becoming one of the first shareholders to directly press for the step in hopes of boosting valuation.

top_signals.title: As Japan’s cities get denser, could greener rooftops replace lost gardens?
top_signals.summary: At a recent symposium, architects explored why Japan's rooftops remain underused — and what could happen if that changed.
